profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Silvus Technologies, Inc.
profile.summary: I am an embedded engineer with expertise in scripting, test automation tools, debugging, makefiles, bootloader, build, release, integration and continuous integration (CI) for Android devices and RTOS devices. I also have experience in device drivers, board bring-up using ARM assembly language, memory managemnet and low power optimization. I can debug a library down to an assembly level.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Regression test using Jenkins and Python
Power control of radio transmission power (Linux)
board bring-up using uBoot  on Xilinx 7z100 Zynq board

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Continuous Integration (CI):
Using Jenkins, Python, shell scripts, CouchDB and MySQL, worked on tools to continuously build, test and integrate.
Analyzed build failures and informed the code submitters.
Using XML and REST API, created Jenkins jobs to create, modify and delete Jenkins jobs. 
Performed Jenkins slave label assignments due to limited resources.
Created CI Metrics (measured build time improvements)
Worked with QA team to create test cases.
Used Docker to contain a build process so that multiple builds do not interfere with each other. (One example of a concurrent build problem was that Android Nougat used Jack-server which allowed only one build process per machine. Since we had powerful machines, we wanted to build more than one at a time.)
Fixed Unicode string conversion problems. Developers were from all over the world and used different languages. Unicode to ascii conversion was causing CI program to crash.
Fixed disk space problems due to Jenkins operations.

Android OS (FireOS) Build Optimization: ( FireOS is a variant of Android OS.)
I debugged and fixed build errors. Worked on improving and optimizing the build processes using Android makefiles. Worked on multi architecture support (64-bit and 32-bit). Integrated changes from different Android versions to Kindile FireOS. Helped internal engineers with various makefile problems. Analyzed build-time data and stored the data in CouchDB. The data were used later to optimize the build speed (e.g. with faster SSD drive). Used Ccache to improve the build speed. Utilized prebuilt libraries to speed up the build process. I debugged the errors due to the library of a wrong architecture being loaded.

Porting:
Ported Android download tools from Linux environment (Ubuntu 64 bit) to Raspberry Pi environment (32 bit).

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Debugged power consumption issues for Android phones under Linux environment. 
Debugged wake-locks, power domains and GPIO configurations. 
Debugged Android/Linux Kernel, drivers, Kernel panic, memory issued, makefiles, Windows tools (C and Java), integration, build and release.

positions.title: Senior Firmware Engineer
positions.description: Wrote device drivers and Windows tools for 802.16 WiMax.

positions.title: Software engineer
positions.description: Wrote device drivers and Windows tools for cellular phones.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Device driver and User interface lead software engineer. Wrote device drivers and user interface for cellular phones.
